scope: Steady reference-construction sensitivity, not operating limits or temperature qualification.
interpretation: CORE is physically scoped against a PlayStation-class processor as an architectural assumption, not a verified implementation or a measured CPU wattage. The common 5 W heat input is a combined CORE/GFX diagnostic, not a Sony chip rating. The 10 W and 14 W total internal-heat cases are BMSX sensitivity examples, not derived from or identical to the consumption of any PlayStation model.
Heat loads and room examples are diagnostics, not measured consumption or permitted operating conditions.
ASIC package power, PVT and junction conditions remain unqualified; no universal junction or bulk-air limit is assigned.
Plastic conductivity and convection/emissivity/contact values are sensitivity assumptions, not selected material-grade properties.
The three aluminium regions and three inner/outer tray regions remain separate; no whole-enclosure isothermal boundary is imposed.
The aligned lower openings are series restrictions; no extra buoyancy credit is taken from the lower tray height.
Stationary gap conduction/radiation is a diagnostic local heat path; lateral gap circulation, local hotspots, cartridge heat return and detailed PCB/package heat paths are not resolved.
Old exposed-aluminium temperatures are not temperatures of the present plastic exterior.
